name: WeChat Digest Tools
description: Expose the local WeChat digest project to OpenClaw as fixed, one-shot tools.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the wechat-digest project root. Defaults to the linked plugin's grandparent directory.

cliPath.description: Optional path to wechat-digest executable. Defaults to .venv/Scripts/wechat-digest.exe on Windows.

configPath.description: Project config path. Defaults to config.yaml under projectRoot.

envPath.description: Project .env path. Defaults to .env under projectRoot.

channel.description: Only claim wd commands from this OpenClaw channel. Empty means any channel.

prefix.description: Command prefix to claim. Defaults to wd.

allowGroupCommands.description: Whether wd commands in group chats should be claimed. Defaults to false.

maxReplyChars.description: Maximum characters returned to WeChat/OpenClaw. Defaults to 6000.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for each local CLI execution. Defaults to 600000.
